name: Fukutaro Kakizaki
source: The protagonist's meets Kakizaki after she leaves the Mikozuka lab during her first day of investigation. Upon seeing the protagonist, Kakizaki becomes extremely terrified and runs away from her. What the reason may have been behind his sudden departure is unknown.
